description: Migrate from Jest to Vitest in the CDK project. Replace jest, ts-jest, and @types/jest with vitest. Replace jest.config.ts with vitest.config.ts. Update test file imports if needed. Delete old Jest snapshot so Vitest regenerates it. Update package.json scripts. Update documentation references.
steps: Step 1: Remove Jest dependencies and add Vitest. In cdk/package.json: (a) Remove 'jest', 'ts-jest', '@types/jest' from devDependencies. (b) Add 'vitest' (^4.0.18) to devDependencies. (c) Update scripts: change 'test' from 'jest' to 'vitest run', change 'test:coverage' from 'jest --coverage' to 'vitest run --coverage', change 'test:watch' from 'jest --watch' to 'vitest watch'. (d) Run npm install to update package-lock.json.

Step 2: Delete cdk/jest.config.ts and create cdk/vitest.config.ts following the reference pattern from the weather-site repo. Config should have: globals: true, environment: 'node', include: ['test/**/*.test.ts']. Use the same Prettier formatting conventions (singleQuote, no semi, es5 trailing commas).

Step 3: Review cdk/test/cdk.test.ts. With globals: true in vitest config, describe/it/expect/beforeEach work without imports. The toMatchSnapshot() API is compatible. No changes should be needed to this file, but verify by running the tests.
Step 4: Delete the old Jest snapshot file at cdk/test/__snapshots__/cdk.test.ts.snap. Vitest will regenerate it automatically on first test run.
Step 5: Run npm run build to ensure TypeScript still compiles (vitest.config.ts should not cause type errors since it is excluded by tsconfig outDir pattern).
Step 6: Run npm test to confirm Vitest runs all tests and regenerates the snapshot.
Step 7: Run npm run check (lint:ci + format:ci) to ensure no lint or formatting issues.

Step 8: Update documentation references. In CONTRIBUTING.md: change 'Jest' references to 'Vitest' in the TypeScript Code Style section (line 109) and CDK tests section (lines 153-156) and CI section (line 224). In CLAUDE.md: no Jest references to change. In .kiro/steering/typescript-cdk.md: update Testing section - change tools reference from Jest-specific to Vitest, update snapshot commands. In .kiro/steering/structure.md: update references to Jest in CDK test descriptions. In .kiro/steering/tech.md: update CDK test command references.
Step 9: Update cdk/eslint.config.mjs ignores if needed - vitest.config.ts is a .ts file so should be handled by existing config. Verify no issues.
Step 10: Commit all changes with a conventional commit message like 'refactor(cdk): migrate from jest to vitest'.
acceptance_criteria: jest, ts-jest, and @types/jest are removed from cdk/package.json devDependencies
vitest is added to cdk/package.json devDependencies
cdk/package.json test scripts use vitest commands
cdk/vitest.config.ts exists with globals: true, environment: 'node', include: ['test/**/*.test.ts']
cdk/test/cdk.test.ts has no jest-specific imports (none were present before either)
cdk/test/__snapshots__/cdk.test.ts.snap is regenerated by Vitest (header says Vitest Snapshot, not Jest Snapshot)
npm test exits 0 with all tests passing
npm run check exits 0 (lint + format pass)
CONTRIBUTING.md, .kiro/steering/typescript-cdk.md, .kiro/steering/structure.md, and .kiro/steering/tech.md are updated to reference Vitest instead of Jest
verification: Verify vitest.config.ts exists and jest.config.ts does not exist
Verify snapshot file header references Vitest not Jest
grep -r 'jest' cdk/package.json should only appear in zero hits (no Jest references remain)
grep -ri 'jest' CONTRIBUTING.md .kiro/steering/ should return zero hits
